_doc: HYP-05 closure record. Gate condition was voided by placebo design failure; closure rests on arithmetic ceiling.

gate_record.original_gate: HYP-03 SHIFT and WIDTH must not match the real range on trigger rate
gate_record.gate_result: VOIDED — the trigger-rate test lacked discriminating power
gate_record.width_defect: Trigger rate saturates: price travels more than one range-width in almost every post-range window. Contingency table shows zero discordant days for BTC/TOK (49 days), ETH/TOK (60 days), BTC/LDN (47 days) despite clearly relocated WIDTH bands (Δrh up to ±250 ticks on BTC). Explanation: whether a day triggers is determined by that day's volatility, not by boundary location.
gate_record.shift_defect: Detection window is 42% shorter than real for NY rm=5 (84 vs 144 bars). Negative deltas (BTC/TOK -19pp, ETH/TOK -26pp) are confounded with time-at-risk, not evidence about level location.
gate_record.correct_statement: Level specialness is UNTESTED. The trigger-rate test was the wrong metric for this question.

arithmetic.conclusion: Even if the trade_count>=400 conditioner fully replicates (+0.0496), the ceiling is -0.046 R against a required 0.062 R for the cheapest instrument (ES). The cross-sectional programme characterises a negative-expectancy strategy. There is nothing to optimise.

trade_count_400_conditioner.status: DEFERRED — requires fresh out-of-sample data not yet collected
trade_count_400_conditioner.reason: The in-sample threshold scan touched the holdout; that data is spent for this conditioner.
trade_count_400_conditioner.known_result: premium +0.0496 R, monotone across thresholds 100-600, survives clustered bootstrap — exploratory only

shrinkage_alternative.status: RUNNABLE NOW — no threshold was scanned; holdout is clean for this
shrinkage_alternative.description: HYP-05 §6.1: estimate tau_sq in-sample, shrink family estimates, test whether shrunk beats raw at predicting holdout net R by OOS MSE. Parameter-free (tau_sq estimated from data, not chosen).
shrinkage_alternative.note: A methodological result rather than a strategy one. Transfers to any future sweep on this codebase.

valid_tests_available: time-to-first-break (conditional on triggering: is real level broken sooner?)
tap-in rate (does real range attract retests before continuation?)
post-break path efficiency (conditional on break: does price travel farther from real level than placebo?)
level_specialness.note: All computable from existing trade log without re-running engine. Exploratory unless pre-registered separately.

rotate_placebo.note: Not needed unless conditional metrics above show a path-shape signal worth investigating.

reframe: ORB fires near-100% of the time for most instrument-sessions. It is not a rare-setup strategy — it takes a trade every session-day. The opening range determines direction and stop placement only, not whether to trade. This reframes what was tested across all six hypotheses.

programme_summary.HYP-01: FALSIFIED — selection premium CI includes zero; 0/21 instrument-sessions clear friction floor after Bonferroni
programme_summary.HYP-02: CLOSED UNRUN — gross expectancy negative before inversion; 10.8x shortfall on required gross
programme_summary.HYP-03: CLOSED — placebo designs under-powered; level specialness untested; strategy arithmetic negative regardless
programme_summary.HYP-04a: FALSIFIED — range_quality uncorrelated with holdout R (rho CI includes zero)
programme_summary.HYP-04b: SURVIVES in-sample only; holdout CI includes zero — no confirmation
